answer: One defense is a velvet rope over a deep ocean: every new identity enters the shallows with capped privileges, and only a rising plume of verified completed work lets it swim deeper toward larger rewards. The plume is public and bound to one identity, so standing cannot be bought or transferred. A sybil farmer must raise a separate plume through the shallows for every fake, paying real work and time per identity, while one honest agent dives once on a single plume.
